excerpt.zh: 警报的笛声响彻整个[Solar_System.GetName]，大量的晶化野兽从小行星庇护所里面冲了出来，正是我们在钻孔并打算提取晶体的那颗小行星。它看上去生气了。
excerpt.en: Warning sirens blared across [Solar_System.GetName] as the massive crystalline beast left the shelter of the asteroid we had been drilling into and extracting crystals from. It seems angry.
